summary: Iter20 frontend-only testing of 3 new features PASSED on preview URL. (1) DIGEST SCOPE CONTROL (advisor /tasks): digest-settings-card renders with Toggle + 24-option hour Select ('12:00 AM' .. '11:00 PM', 'ET' label present). Changing hour to 10 fires PUT /api/advisor/digest-settings and shows 'Digest settings saved' toast. Toggling off disables the hour select (verified disabled=True). Reload shows persisted values (hour=10, disabled). Final restore to {enabled:true, hour:8} per request. (2) NUDGE UNDO (advisor /clients → Opportunities): nudge-all-button opens nudge-all-modal listing households with 'Nudge 9 goals' apply button; clicking nudge-all-apply closes modal and shows 'Nudged 9 goals across 8 households' toast with Undo action button (sonner action, duration 8s). Clicking Undo triggers POST /api/advisor/nudge-restore and shows 'Reverted 9 goals' toast. Per-row nudge flow (nudge-goals-<i> → nudge-modal) still opens correctly. (3) TOUR REPLAY (client /my-plan): Welcome tour appears for new client, tour-skip dismisses it, replay-tour link visible in footer. Clicking replay-tour re-opens welcome-tour at tour-step-0 (tour-back absent, tour-next present). tour-next advances to tour-step-1, tour-back returns to step-0, two more tour-next calls reach the last step where tour-finish appears and dismisses the overlay. my-plan-page continues to render. (4) REGRESSION: Advisor TaskBoard loads with DigestSettings card above the Open/Done columns; existing iter19 TEST task still listed with Complete/clear/date controls present.

issues: Uses native browser <input type='date'> picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar component — inconsistent with the rest of the app and does not honor Canadian date formatting. Pre-existing from earlier iterations, re-flagged.

critical_code_review_comments: TaskBoard.jsx DigestSettings: default `s = q.data || { enabled: true, hour: 8 }` means the Toggle/Select render with 8:00 AM during initial load before GET resolves — any click in that window would persist the default state over the server value. Low risk but prefer rendering a skeleton while q.isLoading.

TaskBoard.jsx DigestSettings: toggle+select onChange call save.mutate immediately on every change. The hour <select> fires once per selection which is fine, but there is no debounce or optimistic-update, so the UI briefly shows the old value while PUT is in flight. Consider setQueryData for optimistic UX.

AdvisorClients.jsx nudgeAllMut toast action.onClick -> undoMut.mutate(applied||[]): if the undo payload is a very large array, it is sent in a single POST. Server routers/advisor.py already handles this; just worth noting the request body size scales linearly with nudged-goal count.

AdvisorClients.jsx undoMut only invalidates ['clients']; if the user has an opps-views cache open, those stay stale until the next refetch. Harmless but inconsistent with nudgeAllMut (same issue — both should also invalidate ['opps-views']).

MyPlan.jsx 'Replay tour' button is embedded inside a

and inherits paragraph text styles. Semantically fine but screen-reader label would benefit from aria-label='Replay welcome tour'.
server.py router split (iter19 note) remains in place; routers/{auth,planning,advisor,tasks,compliance}.py all exercised indirectly through the frontend flows and no 5xx seen.
Pre-existing WelcomeTour welcomeKey falls back to `compass_welcome_seen_` when user is null during hydration (shared across users) — same note as iter18/iter19.
